The wooden pilings in the foreground have a smeared, painterly texture. The tops of the pilings are irregular and some appear to melt into the water surface without a clear waterline intersection.
The hull of the fireboat sits ambiguously in the water. There is no clear displacement wake or bow wave consistent with a vessel of that size, making it look slightly pasted onto the water surface.
The background buildings exhibit a uniform, synthetic blur that does not perfectly match atmospheric perspective, contributing to a 'miniature' or diorama effect.
